projectSummary: Establishes that operator experience is a measurable source of error in the ultrasound method most of the tier-1 trials in this slice rely on, which is one reason the tier-1 certainty here is low.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

notes: Abstract-only; used for a qualifier only.

study.intervention: Validity and repeatability study of panoramic ultrasound against MRI.
study.population: Both sides of the chest of 16 participants (n = 32) were assessed to quantify measurement errors in panoramic ultrasound estimation of pectoralis major anatomical cross-sectional area, during image acquisition and analysis (repeatability) and against magnetic resonance imaging (validity), and to analyse the influence of operator experience on those errors.

title: Pectoralis Cross-Sectional Area can be Accurately Measured using Panoramic Ultrasound: A Validity and Repeatability Study.
